title: Fabergé figure bought in 1934 resurfaces in New York attic 79 years later, sells for $5.2 million
summary_full: After being lost to time, a stunning Fabergé figurine depicting a bodyguard to Empress Alexandra Feodorovna has emerged from an attic in Rhinebeck, New York. Fetching an impressive $5.2 million at auction, this piece, originally commissioned by Emperor Nicholas II, epitomizes the exquisite craftsmanship of the early 20th century, setting a record for Fabergé hardstone figures and reflecting a renewed fascination with imperial Russian artistry.
